item.title: Senior ASO Specialist (iOS, iGaming)
item.description:
Привіт! 👋

Ми — Leadsdoit, performance marketing компанія українського походження. Шукаємо досвідченого Senior ASO Specialist, який зможе самостійно розвивати напрямок iOS-додатків у вертикалі iGaming.

 

 

Ти матимеш свободу у прийнятті рішень, власний напрямок і підтримку нашої in-house команди розробки, дизайну та QA.

 

🚀 Твої задачі:

  • Розробка ASO-стратегії для iOS-додатків: аналіз конкурентів, GEO та планування запусків.
  • Робота з метаданими, семантикою, локалізацією та просуванням в App Store.
  • Запуск, оптимізація та масштабування Apple Search Ads (ASA).
  • Робота з рейтингами, відгуками, реджектами та банами.
  • Аналіз результатів: installs, FTD, profit.
  • Впровадження AI-автоматизацій для оптимізації власних процесів.

 

🎯 Що для нас важливо:

  • 2+ роки досвіду в ASO, з них щонайменше останній рік — актуальна робота з iOS.
  • Практичний досвід саме в iGaming.
  • Самостійний запуск і масштабування прибуткових ASA-кампаній.
  • Розуміння повного циклу просування iOS-додатків та їхньої економіки.
  • Досвід роботи з AppsFlyer або аналогами.
  • Практичний досвід створення власних AI-автоматизацій.
  • Реальні кейси з цифрами та готовність самостійно відповідати за результат.

 

💎 Що пропонуємо:

  • Конкурентна ставка + % від чистого профіту твого напрямку.
  • Remote або робота з офісу в Лісабоні з можливістю релокації після випробувального терміну.
  • Власний напрямок, ресурси та підтримка in-house команди.
  • Перспектива розвитку до Team Lead ASO та формування власної команди.

  • Пряма комунікація з CEO.

     

📩 Зацікавила позиція? Надсилай CV.

Будемо раді знайомству! 🚀

item.title: iOS Developer (Swift)
item.description:
Phoenix Games is an innovative technology company building next-generation iGaming and Web3 products for a global audience. We combine AI, blockchain, and cloud technologies to create engaging, secure, and high-performance digital experiences.

We're looking for a talented iOS Developer to help build world-class mobile applications that deliver exceptional user experiences and support millions of users worldwide.

 

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain native iOS applications using Swift.
  • Build scalable, secure, and high-performance mobile solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Developers, and QA Engineers.
  • Integrate REST APIs, WebSockets, and third-party SDKs.
  • Optimize application performance, stability, and responsiveness.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Contribute to application architecture and continuous product improvements.
  • Stay up to date with the latest iOS technologies and best practices.

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial iOS development experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Swift.
  • Experience building and maintaining native iOS applications.
  • Experience with SwiftUI and/or UIKit.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs.
  • Understanding of mobile architecture patterns.
  • Experience with Git.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in iGaming, FinTech, or high-load consumer applications.
  • Experience with real-time features and WebSockets.
  • Familiarity with Web3 or blockchain technologies.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD.
  • Experience publishing applications to the App Store.

 

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work from anywhere in Europe.
  • Long-term B2B cooperation.
  • Competitive salary paid in EUR or USD.
  • Annual salary reviews.
  • Performance-based bonus program.
  • Annual company bonus.
  • 25 paid vacation days.
  • Paid sick leave.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Home office budget.
  • Laptop or equipment allowance.
  • Learning & development budget for courses, certifications, books, and conferences.
  • English language lessons.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Mental health support program.
  • Sports and wellness compensation.
  • Team-building activities and international company retreats.
  • Opportunity to work on innovative AI, Web3, and mobile products with a global audience.
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing international product company.

 

Why Join Phoenix Games?

At Phoenix Games, you'll build modern iOS applications using the latest technologies in a collaborative, product-focused environment. You'll have the opportunity to influence product decisions, solve challenging technical problems, and contribute to innovative solutions that shape the future of digital entertainment.

item.title: IOS Farmer
item.description:

Буде плюсом:

Що пропонуємо:

• Гібридний формат роботи в комфортному офісі у Києві з зонами відпочинку

• Стабільну оплату без затримок

• Навчання та підтримку на старті

• Сильну команду

• Чіткі процеси та зрозумілі задачі

• Можливість впливати на результат і швидко рости

item.title: Senior Mainframe Assembler Developer (HLASM / z/OS)
item.description:
Senior Mainframe Assembler Developer (HLASM / z/OS)

Project Details

  • Location: Central & Eastern Europe
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Duration: Long-term

  • Rate: $23–25/hour (B2B)

     

We are looking for an experienced Senior Mainframe Assembler Developer to join a long-term project focused on developing, optimizing, and maintaining low-level applications within an IBM mainframe environment.

The role requires deep expertise in HLASM, IBM z/OS, system-level debugging, and performance optimization.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Mainframe Assembler (HLASM) code.
  • Analyze complex system requirements and implement reliable low-level solutions.
  • Debug production issues, analyze system dumps, and resolve critical incidents.
  • Optimize application performance, memory usage, and I/O operations.
  • Integrate Assembler modules with COBOL, PL/I, and Java applications.
  • Work with IBM mainframe technologies, including z/OS, CICS, IMS, and DB2.
  • Troubleshoot system-level issues using IPCS, SYSUDUMP, and specialized debugging tools.
  • Collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to ensure system stability.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer.

Requirements

  • 7–10+ years of professional Assembler development experience, including at least 5 years working with mainframe systems.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in HLASM (High Level Assembler).
  • Deep understanding of IBM mainframe architecture, instruction sets, and macros.
  • Strong experience with IBM z/OS, MVS, CICS, IMS, and DB2.
  • Knowledge of VSAM, GDGs, and JCL.
  • Understanding of memory management, I/O operations, and interrupt handling.
  • Experience with low-level debugging and dump analysis using IPCS and SYSUDUMP.
  • Familiarity with IBM Debug Tool, Abend-AID, OMEGAMON, or Fault Analyzer.
  • Experience integrating Assembler modules with COBOL, PL/I, or Java.
  • Understanding of APIs, MQ messaging, and middleware.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and experience supporting knowledge transfer.

Nice to Have

  • IBM Certified System Programmer certification.
  • IBM z/OS Mastery certifications.
  • Experience mentoring other mainframe developers.

 

 

If you have extensive hands-on HLASM expertise and enjoy solving complex system-level challenges within IBM mainframe environments, we'd be happy to hear from you!

item.title: iOS Swift Engineer
item.description:
Cropwise Operations is part of Syngenta Digital, the technology arm of one of the world’s largest agriculture companies. We build mobile apps that help agronomists across 50+ countries plan planting, protect crops, and manage harvest. They run on satellite data and machine learning, and they work fully offline.

 

We’re looking for a skilled iOS Engineer to join our team. You’ll work on geolocation-heavy features, offline-first architecture, and performance-critical components that help farmers around the world make better decisions.

 

Must-Have Skills

 

  • Swift
  • UIKit
  • SwiftUI
  • Swift Concurrency (async/await)
  • 3+ years of commercial iOS development

 

Nice to Have

 

  • You enjoy data-heavy apps and keeping backend, database, and UI in sync through local persistence and caching
  • Mapbox SDK or other geospatial experience
  • Testing with XCTest, Swift Testing, and UI tests
  • C/C++ interop or geospatial libraries (GDAL)
  • Profiling with Instruments (performance, memory)
  • Agentic engineering, using AI agents for refactoring, codebase research, or feature delivery
  • CI/CD, build and release automation, scripting

 

What You’ll Work On

 

  • Developing a mobile application that interacts with a SaaS platform for agronomic data processing
  • Integrating with geolocation and mapping services (Mapbox, GPS, etc.)
  • Implementing UI components using SwiftUI
  • Building and maintaining the offline-first data layer (local storage, caching, synchronization), a core hands-on part of the role
  • Keeping the app fast through performance and memory optimization in critical code paths
  • Evolving a mature production codebase, including gradual UIKit to SwiftUI migration as part of ongoing architecture work

 

The Company Offers

 

  • Company-paid subscriptions to AI coding agents and tools
  • Continuous learning through training and development programs
  • Flexible work format (remote, office, or hybrid)
  • Health and life insurance for employees and their family members
  • 32 working days of paid annual leave and sick leave

item.title: iOS developer
item.description:
Компанія molfar.io шукає junior iOS-розробника.
Ми виконуємо повний цикл створення програмних продуктів. Допомагаємо нашим клієнтам пройти весь шлях від ідеї до запуску.


Вас буде радувати:

– Навчання під керівництвом Team Lead'a. 
– Участь у проектуванні архітектури майбутніх проектів.

– Усередині компанії ми підтримуємо інженерну культуру. 
– Ми не працюємо за годинником, не “трекаємо” час. Нас цінують за пунктуальність, помірний перфекціонізм та увагу до деталей. Ці якості будуть потрібні і від вас.
 

Перевагами для вас будуть:
– Оплачуваний компанією час на саморозвиток.
– Внутрішні хакатони, технічні доповіді.
– Оплата компанією курсів та літератури.
– Прогресивні підходи у розробці ПЗ.
– Участь у код-рев’ю.


Дуже будемо раді, якщо у вас є вища технічна освіта та інженерне мислення, а також знання англійської мови.


Ви нам підходите, якщо ви:
– Маєте досвід роботи більше 6 місяців.
– Пишете на Swift, знайомі з Objective-C.
– Знайомі з Core Data, Realm, GCD, URLSession.
– Використовуєте багатопоточність.
– Знаєте шаблони проектування, алгоритми та структури даних.
– Брали участь у розробці складних елементів інтерфейсу.
– Вмієте і прагнете писати гнучкий код, що перевикористовується.
– Вмієте оцінювати терміни.
– Володієте англійською на рівні Intermediate.
– Знайомство з основами реактивного та функціонального програмування буде перевагою.

item.title: iOS Developer
item.description:
We are looking for a hands-on iOS Developer to join a funded consumer startup in Sofia. It is building a new kind of app that sits between social video and gaming. The product is already live on the App Store, and you will build and ship features for real users from day one. You will work on a TikTok-style endless feed of mini-games made by users, where performance, smooth scrolling and fast iteration really matter. The role covers the whole feature cycle: quick prototypes, A/B tests, App Store releases and tracking results in mobile analytics. You will work closely with a senior iOS engineer and the leadership team in a small, fast-moving team where your work is seen right away. We want someone who takes ownership, enjoys working on-site with the team and likes to ship often.

 

Details:

  • Schedule: Full time
  • Location: Onsite – Sofia, Bulgaria (if you don't live there yet, you need to move to Sofia within about 1 month)
  • Start: ASAP
  • Duration: Long-term
  • English: Fluent
  • Type of collaboration: Internal Employment (full-time employment contract; B2B is not possible)

 

About the project:
The company is a funded consumer startup creating a new category between social video and gaming. Its app has an endless, TikTok-style feed of short mini-games made by users, which people can play, share and create. The product is live on the App Store, and the team is hiring more engineers for its Sofia office. The company works like a typical startup: it prototypes fast, releases often and makes decisions based on experiments and data. Engineers own their features and work directly with product and leadership. It is a great place for someone who wants to shape a fast-growing B2C product that real players use every day.

 

You have:

  • 5+ years of professional iOS development experience
  • A track record of shipping production iOS apps to the App Store
  • Strong Swift skills and hands-on experience with SwiftUI and UIKit
  • Experience with WKWebView and showing web content inside native apps
  • Experience with App Store releases, A/B testing and mobile analytics
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup with quick prototypes and tight deadlines
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a habit of taking ownership
  • Fluent English
  • EU citizenship or a current Bulgarian/Schengen visa (visa sponsorship is not available)
  • You live in Sofia or can move there within about 1 month, and you are ready to work fully on-site

 

Nice to have:

  • Experience building B2C consumer apps
  • Experience at early-stage startups
  • Experience in iGaming, betting or mobile gaming (including hyper-casual games)
  • Experience with social, video or feed-based apps

 

What to do:

  • Build, ship and maintain features for a live consumer iOS app using Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit
  • Build and improve the endless mini-game feed, with a focus on performance and a smooth user experience
  • Integrate and optimize web-based game content inside the app using WKWebView
  • Prototype new ideas quickly and turn the ones that work into production features
  • Set up and run A/B tests, and use mobile analytics to measure how features perform
  • Own the App Store release process together with the team
  • Work closely with the senior iOS engineer, product and leadership on priorities and technical decisions
  • Do code reviews and help keep code quality high as the product grows

 

Interview process:

  1. Intro call with the senior iOS engineer
  2. Technical interview with the iOS engineer
  3. Final round with leadership to discuss the offer (with an optional office visit)
